hook.line: "I created Rhode's 2026 campaign" — then she admits it was a mock campaign.
hook.visual: Face to camera with mic and big white 'i created', then fast cuts to a glossy lips shot, 'rhode 2026 harvest season' and a product collage.

beats.what: Claim on camera with word-by-word white caption 'i created'.
Cut to a close-up lips image with 'rhode' over it: the result is shown first.
Full-screen campaign key visual 'rhode 2026 / harvest season', then a product collage.
Back on her face for the twist: she didn't actually make it, it is a mock portfolio campaign.
Short intro: who she is and the 'come on this journey' account premise.
Step 1: pick a brand that fits your skills and interests.
Burst of quick product-image cutaways (teddy bear, lip tint) while she explains why she chose the brand.
Hero campaign revealed on a laptop: the mock 'harvest season' site.
Moodboard collage of her campaign visuals for the 'collect your visuals' step.
Rapid cuts over the laptop as she pulls everything into one strategy document.

why_it_works: Bait-and-switch hook: a too-good claim plus the finished campaign visuals in the first 3 s (4 cuts in the hook window), then an honest twist that makes you want to see how.
The pretty end product is shown before the method, so the viewer stays for the step-by-step.
Cutaways cluster in bursts (0.3-0.7 s shots around 35-38 s and 109-113 s) right when she names visuals, so the long talking stretches are broken by eye candy.
Comment CTA asks a specific, easy question (which brand did you pick), which invites replies.
weaknesses: Long talking-only stretches (longest shot almost 20 s) in the middle steps with only the caption moving.
133 s is long for a list of steps; the step names are never shown as titles, so it is hard to skim.
Two CTAs (comment, then follow) stacked at the end dilute each other.
for_robert: Use the bait-and-switch open: state the big claim over the finished result, then cut back to his face for the honest 'okay, not exactly' — Fred could pop in and give a side-eye on the twist.
